goal: Normalize consumer eSIM provisioning and activation into independently evidenced lifecycle stages and failure categories so SolQvia can identify where setup stopped.
evidence_rules: QR/link/manual activation material success does not prove profile download.
Profile download does not prove installation.
Profile installation does not prove enablement.
Profile enablement does not prove carrier line activation or network registration.
Network registration does not prove data, voice, SMS or IMS.
Apple user-facing workflows do not expose enough information to infer hidden RSP server stages.
User activation codes, confirmation codes, full EID and subscriber credentials are prohibited from storage.
official_basis: GSMA consumer eSIM specifications page and active SGP.22 references
Apple eSIM activation and cross-platform transfer guidance
au eSIM opening, line-switch and manual-input procedures
next_phase: Phase157 IMS / VoLTE / VoNR evidence matrix and provisioning/runtime separation.
